items.title: Accenture (ACN) Joins 40 Plus Organizations In AI Transparency Initiative
items.summary: Accenture (NYSE:ACN) has joined Microsoft and more than 40 partners in a new AI Transparency Initiative focused on enterprise use. The multi company effort aims to create shared standards for AI security, transparency, and governance in corporate deployments. Accenture is contributing its enterprise consulting and implementation experience to shape practical frameworks for large global clients.
